chapter one

A story that took the long way around

Once, there were two kids in primary school who had no idea that life would keep crossing their paths. You were one of them.
Then school changed, life got busy, and somehow we lost touch. There wasn't a dramatic goodbye. We simply ended up in different chapters.
An old school memory — and somehow, here we are again. 🌸
One evening, our paths crossed again while walking home. We talked for a long time, and somehow that one conversation made the years in between feel a little smaller.
Even after that, we lost contact again. Then, every once in a while — three or four times over the years — we'd randomly meet again. It was almost funny how life kept giving the friendship another chance.
And now, after another year, we're properly back in touch. Good friends again. We still don't have a single picture together, though… so I think that's one thing we definitely need to fix. 😄📸
